children: Coda Octopus Group, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $7.72M, up 10.6% year over year, and net income of $1.39M, an 8.3% increase versus the prior-year quarter.
Revenue was $7.72M for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, compared with $6.98M in the quarter ended July 31, 2025; YoY change 10.6%.
Net income was $1.39M for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, compared with $1.28M in the quarter ended July 31, 2025; YoY change 8.3%.
Consolidated net revenues rose 9.2% sequentially, led by strong Services and PAL performance which offset declines in Product sales.
Marine product mix shifted toward higher‑margin rentals, which increased 131% quarter over quarter, while equipment sales declined 17.8%.
PAL sales grew 10.4% sequentially, driven by increased U.S. demand and internal R&D investments supporting the product pipeline.
Defense Services revenue surged 68.3% quarter over quarter following new and expanded DoD subcontract awards and improved project throughput.
Geopolitical instability in the Middle East weighed on demand in Asia and the Middle East; management expects continued regional uncertainty to impact product demand.
